newsitem.title: USA: Olympic Financial says to contest suit.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Financial says to contest suit.

text.p: Olympic Financial Ltd said it will contest a shareholder suit that was filed against it recently.

On Wednesday, the law firm of Heins Mills & Olson said Olympic Financial was named in a class action lawsuit alleging violations of federal securities law. The suit alleged that the company made false and misleading statements and omissions about its loan programs, retail repossession program and its loan loss reserves.

"The company's policy has always been, and will continue to be, complete and accurate disclosure," Richard Greenawalt, chief executive officer, said in a statement issued late Wednesday. "We fully intend to contest the suit and expect to prevail."
Olympic is a consumer finance company that purchases, sells and services prime retail installment contracts for new and used automobiles.
